audit_openrouter_key_note: The key is sent to Verbatims over HTTPS and stored encrypted in D1. Create a separate OpenRouter key capped at $2 for the pilot: our settings limit web search to 5 requests per quote (up to about $0.70 for 20 quotes, plus tokens). The current openai/gpt-5-nano price is $0.05/M input tokens and $0.40/M output tokens. Quote text, authors, references, and image metadata are sent to OpenRouter. Public quotes are never modified.
